glosses: Capable or clever; able to put available resources to efficient or ingenious use; using materials at hand wisely or efficiently.

examples.text: With a resourceful use of space and a fresh coat of paint, the room became a pleasant library with a comfortable seating area.

glosses: Self-governing. Intelligent, sentient, self-aware, thinking, feeling, governing independently.
Acting on one's own or independently; of a child, acting without being governed by parental or guardian rules.

examples.text: Though Cade has for years reported on the development of autonomous vehicles, test drives usually have so-called safety drivers who ride along and can take over in case something goes wrong.

glosses: Used with no subject, indicating an unknown or unspecified agent; used in similar situations as the passive in English (the difference being that the theme in the English passive construction is the subject, while in the Celtic autonomous construction the theme is the object and there is no subject).
Directed, independently by oneself without external control or constraint; directed for oneself.

examples.text: I see a lot of self-directed anger on the part of the straight wives: What's wrong with me that I can't keep this man attracted to me? What's wrong with me in the first place for attracting a gay man?

glosses: Reliant upon oneself; trusting to one's own powers or judgment.

examples.text: The Constitution deliberately makes the President and the Congress competitors as well as partners. The Founding Fathers created an elaborate system of checks and balances to keep each partner self-reliant while still assuring their interdependence. No brief account can fully capture the complexity of this relationship, in which each partner contributes his own share of stubbornness, pride, hostility, warmth, suspicion, skill, and affection.

glosses: Que puede hacer muy bien algo.
Que tiene las cualidades, condiciones o requisitos adecuados para algo.

examples.text: El tiempo hábil de una convocatoria es el periodo en que se puede responder a ella, en que está vigente.
